note: New path only (kit install/plan/verify/update). The legacy installer keeps reading mcp/manifest.json and mcp/allowlist.json. Fields: 04_DESIGN 3.6, rules: kit/mcp_catalog.py.

sequential-thinking.license: package says 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE' (modelcontextprotocol/servers, moving from MIT to Apache-2.0); 2025.12.18 declared MIT
sequential-thinking.network_egress: npm registry download on first start; the server itself is not expected to use the network (not verified)
sequential-thinking.lifecycle_scripts: registry package has no install scripts ('prepare' runs only for git installs)

playwright.disabled_reason: opens a real browser and visits any URL the agent chooses; first start downloads the package and may need browser binaries. Opt in with --mcp playwright
playwright.network_egress: npm registry download on first start; the browser reaches any site the agent opens
playwright.file_access: browser profile and downloads in a temporary directory; reads files the agent uploads
playwright.lifecycle_scripts: none in @playwright/mcp@0.0.84, playwright and playwright-core 1.65.0-alpha-2026-10-30 (npm view, 2026-11-06)

context7.disabled_reason: sends the library names and questions the agent looks up to context7.com. Opt in with --mcp context7; works without a key (lower rate limits)
context7.network_egress: npm registry download on first start; context7.com API for every lookup
context7.lifecycle_scripts: none in @upstash/context7-mcp@4.5.1 or its 12 direct dependencies (npm view, 2026-11-06)

credentials.purpose: higher rate limits and private repositories; without it the server runs keyless (an unset ${CONTEXT7_API_KEY} placeholder is ignored by 4.5.1)

fetch.disabled_reason: fetches arbitrary URLs: can send task data outside the workspace. Listed only (no pinned version)

git.disabled_reason: exposes git operations including remote sync; the agents already run git through the shell with approval. Listed only (no pinned version)

filesystem.disabled_reason: duplicates the agents' own file access and widens the reachable paths. Listed only (no pinned version)
